svg.text: Target design · one AWS Region · two Availability Zones · nothing in the VPC is reachable from the internet · backups copied to a second Region
EDGE · AWS GLOBAL NETWORK, IN FRONT OF THE REGION
every file is stored across 3+ zones
private app subnets in both zones · reached only through CloudFront
AWS Lambda · outside the VPC, no database access
resizes photos · removes GPS location data
flags hidden phone numbers → workers' queue
NAT gateway only · route to the internet gateway
PRIVATE DATA SUBNET · 10.20.20.0/24 · no internet route
PRIVATE DATA SUBNET · 10.20.21.0/24 · no internet route
load balancer, app, workers; out via NAT
no internet route, in or out
global, in front of the Region
Dashed box: standby, used only on failure
HTTPS to CloudFront; WAF checks every request
Photos come from the CloudFront cache; S3 is read only on a miss
Uncached requests reach the private load balancer through a VPC origin
Load balancer shares requests between two zones; one zone can fail
Money and permission actions always use the source of truth
Searches use the index; workers keep it up to date
Database copies every change to the standby in zone B
Files go to S3 through the free gateway endpoint, never the internet
AI checks, CRMs, and SMS are called through each zone's NAT gateway
New photo triggers Lambda: resize, strip GPS data, flag hidden numbers
